description: Localisation des stations de vélo en libre service sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Couche de points permettant de connaître l'emplacement des stations de prêt du système de vélo en libre service (VLS) "LE vélo STAR" de la Ville de Rennes et notamment les anciennes stations aujourd'hui démantelées. Cette couche n'a pas vocation à être à jour. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are moyen de transport, bicyclette. The portal shows 101 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
